dialect.detail: PC-based COBOL (likely Micro Focus or compatible) targeting PC-XT/AT, using COMP-4, ACCEPT/DISPLAY with LINE/POSITION clauses, indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC access, and DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (Spanish locale). Dated Nov 1991.
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED / ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC

purpose.domain_detail: Price list generation for articles/products, organized by brand (MARCA) and product line, with pricing in local currency (pesos) and USD, including IVA (VAT) calculations. Likely an Argentine retail/wholesale inventory system.
purpose.summary: This program generates an alphabetical price list (LISTA ALFABETICA DE PRECIOS) for articles stored in indexed files. It reads product data from ART01/ART02 files, computes prices with and without IVA (21%), handles USD vs. peso pricing, and prints formatted reports organized by brand and product line to an output file (IMP02). It also writes intermediate sorted data to a PRELIS3 indexed file.

notable_features: COMP-4 (binary) usage for line/column layout fields
Screen I/O with ACCEPT/DISPLAY LINE POSITION clauses
Indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC access and START/READ NEXT
Heavy use of COPY statements (40 copybooks) for file definitions and error handlers
DECLARATIVES section with error handlers per file
WRITE ... INVALID KEY REWRITE pattern for upsert
52 GO TO statements indicating older structured style
